title: Company settings
description: Per-company configuration served by the host. ledgerbot caches it (LEDGERBOT_TENANT_TTL) and refreshes on a settings.changed event. If the host is unreachable ledgerbot serves the last snapshot in degraded mode, where nothing is written.

save_mode.description: Most permissive mode allowed for the company. Roles may only make it stricter.

ai_daily_limit.description: AI calls per day; 0 = unlimited. Rule-based commands and e-invoice XML do not count.

providers.description: Optional provider profile names (from the deployment's providers file) per purpose.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the full key lb_<company>_<secret>.

signing_secret.description: If set, REST calls must be HMAC-signed (X-Ledgerbot-Signature).

rules.description: Proactive alerts: when an inbound event matches, notify users with these roles on their preferred connected channel.

throttle.description: Go duration; at most one alert per entity and user within it.

prompts.description: Host-provided system instructions appended to ledgerbot's fixed prompt. They add context (sector, tone, vocabulary); they cannot change the output contract.
